translated_title: Mexico's Ambassador Vasconcelos Says at UN That Ending US Blockade Against Cuba Is Urgent and Imperative
original_title: Urgente e imperativo, poner fin al bloqueo de EU contra Cuba dice embajador Vasconcelos ante la ONU
author: Arturo Sánchez Jiménez and Emir Olivares
meta_description: Citing food and medicine shortages and an energy crisis on the island, Mexico also called for Cuba's removal from Washington's list of state sponsors of terrorism.
